installedHelp: Skills are folders with a SKILL.md file that tell coding agents (e.g. Codex) how to do a task. Here you see the installed skills, read the SKILL.md file of a skill, and delete a skill.
findHelp: Skills are folders with a SKILL.md file that tell coding agents (e.g. Codex) how to do a task. Here you find a skill on skills.sh, in a folder on this computer, or in a folder on GitHub or GitLab, read the SKILL.md file of the skill before you install it, and install it for the user or for the workspace.
levelHelp: Where a new skill is installed
searchHelp: Type a word. The search starts when you stop typing.
folderHelp: The folder that holds the file SKILL.md.
folderChooseTitle: Choose the folder of the skill
addressHelp: A folder on GitHub or GitLab that holds the file SKILL.md.
installTitleWorkspace: Install in the folder of the workspace
sourceTitle: Show the source of the file, with colours
noAgent: No coding agent is switched on. Switch one on in the section Agents to install skills.
addLinkTitle: Make this skill available to {agent}, with a link to the real folder
help_level_what_text: The place where Heidrun puts the new skill.
help_level_user_text: The skill goes in the home folder of the developer. Every workspace can use it.
help_level_workspace_text: The skill goes in the folder of the selected workspace. Only this workspace can use it.
help_level_agents_text: Heidrun installs the skill for each coding agent that is switched on in the section Agents.
help_source_label: About the source of the skill
help_source_what_text: The place where Heidrun finds the skill. The choice changes the field below.
help_source_skills_sh_text: A search in the public list of skills.
help_source_code_hosting_text: A folder on GitHub or GitLab, given as a web address.
help_search_what_text: Words to look for in the public list of skills on skills.sh.
help_search_sent_text: Heidrun sends the words that you type to the website skills.sh.
help_search_how_text: The search starts when you stop typing. Each result shows its number of installs.
help_folder_label: About the folder of the skill
help_folder_what_text: A folder on this computer that holds the file SKILL.md. Type the full path, or choose the folder with the button.
help_folder_does_text: Heidrun reads the files of the folder and copies them to the installation level. Nothing is sent over the network.
help_folder_no_file_title: When the folder has no file SKILL.md
help_folder_no_file_text: The window shows an error message, and no result.
help_address_title: Web address of the skill folder
help_address_label: About the web address of the skill folder
help_address_what_text: The web address of the page that GitHub or GitLab shows for a skill folder. The folder holds the file SKILL.md.
help_address_sent_text: Heidrun asks GitHub or GitLab for the files below the folder. The repository must be public.
help_address_fails_text: A private repository or a missing folder gives an error message.
help_result_what_text: The skill that Heidrun found, with its name and its source.
help_result_inspect_text: Shows the file SKILL.md of the skill, so that you can read it before the installation.
help_result_install_text: Installs the skill at the chosen installation level. The row then shows Installed.
